mapper.select: SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , t1.TR_CD AS tr_cd , t1.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , t1.TR_CO_CD AS tr_co_cd , t1.TRUSTEE AS trustee , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , t1.CURRENCY AS currency , t1.TR_SEQ AS tr_seq , t1.TR_JUSU AS tr_jusu , t1.TR_DANGA AS tr_danga , t1.TR_COST AS tr_cost , t1.TR_AEK AS tr_aek , NVL(t1.TR_JUSU, 0) * NVL(ya.HANGSA_GA, 0) * NVL(ya.UNIT_AEK, 1) AS nominal_amt , TO_CHAR(t1.GYULJE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyulje_ymd , t1.GYULJE_JM_CD AS gyulje_jm_cd , t1.TRANS_RT AS trans_rt , t1.UPD_USER AS upd_user , ia.FUND_CURRENCY AS fund_currency , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , NVL(ya.JM_NM, '대기중') AS xx_yj_cd , NVL(ya.JM_NM, '대기중') AS jm_nm , ya.HANGSA_GA AS sym0ya_hangsa_ga , ya.HANGSA_GA AS hangsa_ga , ya.UNIT_AEK AS unit_aek , 1 AS p_visible FROM SYT1MG t1 , SZM0IA ia , SYM0YA ya WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t1.FUND_CD AND ya.CORP_GR(+) = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD(+) = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY t1.FUND_CD ASC, t1.TR_CD ASC, t1.TR_SEQ ASC

SELECT t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , t1.JM_NM AS xx_yj_cd , t1.HANGSA_GA AS sym0ya_hangsa_ga , t1.UNIT_AEK AS unit_aek , t1.CURRENCY AS currency FROM SYM0YA t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd} AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT NVL(MAX(TR_SEQ), 0) FROM SYT1MG WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')
